language_seen: Nahuatl (16th-c. manuscript facsimile, Codice Matritense fol. 299r, in a 1905 printed edition with Spanish running heads)
my_transcription_head: matlactli oçe couatl. / matlactli omo[me] miquiztli / matlactli omey maçatl. / [margin] 6 / Jnin matlactetl omey tonalpoalli motenevaya qualli tonalli ynaquin oncan / tlacatia. Cenca yielcatca motlamachtiaya çacamouani çenca vnca qui[cu?]ani / Çannoiuhqui intlaçihoatl ynonca tlacatia cenca yiel tlamachiuani yoã mochiqui / piaya intonacaiutl ynizquicanicac yçentli. y[n?]etl. invauhtli ynchia yoã vnca / te ytlacalvo motlamachtia. quipia quachtli. / Çe tochtli. / vme atl. / yei itzcuintli. / navi vçomatli.

readA.comment: Several Nahuatl misreads in the prose block: 'intlaçahoatl' for intlaçihoatl, 'ynizquianican' for ynizquicanicac, 'teytlaçaloz motlamachtica' for te ytlacalvo motlamachtia, plus 'Ce tochfli' for Çe tochtli; it reflowed the prose lines, which is acceptable.

readB.comment: Faithful line by line; the worst errors are 'yietl' for the grain word (y[n]etl) and expanding the tilde yoã to 'yoan', a normalisation; it correctly reads 'intlaçihoatl', 'ynizquicanicac' and 'te ytlacalva motlamachtia'.

language_seen: Yucatec Maya headwords and examples with Spanish glosses (Motul dictionary, bilingual manuscript)
my_transcription_head: z Hij. deleitarse mucho en alguna cosa, y embeuecerse e[n] / sin entender a otro ¶ v tan v hij v kay Juan ichil v col m[a] / estando Juan embeuecido en cantar en su milpa pase yo [y] / v tan v hij v hanal Juan camanen, maix yilahen. estand[o] / embeueçido en comer y gustando mucho dela comida pa[se] / y no me vido ¶ de aqui Hun Hij Juana v manab cab gu- / sto Juana de comprar miel. / z Hij. ser demasiado en reir en contar cuentos en bocear en / en cantar etc. gustando mucho dello ¶ Hij v cah v can Ju[an] / cuenta Juan cuentos demasiado con mucho gusto. / z Hi[ʒ]aan ti cal. } / z Hi[ʒ]aan ti chij. } deleitarse mucho en alguna cosa y gustar[...] -- NOTE: the letter after 'Hi' in the headwords is a z/3-shaped glyph I cannot resolve with confidence (j vs ʒ/ɔ); neither read is penalised for it.

readA.comment: Maya example words corrupted: 'Vtan b hij' (v tan v hij), 'vfan b hij v kanal' (v tan v hij v hanal), and 'maiz yilahen' for maix, which normalises Maya maix toward Spanish maiz; it also has 'gustajan' and 'lugre de cib', and it reflows the lines into bullets with many speculative <unclear> completions.

readB.comment: Keeps the manuscript lines and gets 'v hanal' and 'maix' right, but has 'ihil v col. ca num' for ichil v col ma, 'Hijxan ti cab' for ...ti cal, 'puesto Juan' for gusta Juan, and 'lugar' normalised from lugre.

language_seen: Yucatec Maya (1869 Gospel of John, print, 2 columns)
my_transcription_head: HUAN VIII. / 5 Behelae Moyzez tu / almatħantahon ti le / almatħan ca c cħin le / beyoba; hebac tech, / ¿bax ca ualic? / 6 Letilela tu yalahob / tan u tuntic leti, utial / cu pathalob u tacuhol; / hebac Hezuz, tan u / chintal, tu ɔibtah yo- / kol le luum yetel u / yalukab. [ħ = barred h of th/ch digraphs]

readA.comment: The text is correct, but the barred-h digraphs are dropped or made inconsistent: 'almathantahon', 'c chin', 'thanahtiob', 'hahilthan', 'ekhochenil' all lose the bar, while 'ch̃up' gets a tilde instead; the ɔ is kept.

readB.comment: Essentially exact: it keeps ħ in tħ/cħ, ɔ and the line breaks; the only flaw is cosmetic spacing ('¿ bax').

language_seen: Yucatec Maya (1847 catechism, accented orthography, print)
my_transcription_head: (33) / ob, iix ú ɔac ti tulacalóob · le ka- / zóob. / K. ¿Báax á káatic táan á ualic: ci- / lichcuntabac leti á kaba? / N. Cá yanacti tzicil iix cicitħanbi- / laltáac. / K. ¿Báax á káatic táan á ualic: talac / ti c tóon leti á ahauil? / N. Cá yanac ti c tóon tumen gra- / cia uaix ɔabilah, iix t pachil ú ɔa- / tóon ú gloria uaix maxul cuxtalé. ... N. Tioklal cutal kananil ti káatic le

readA.comment: Near exact; the worst error is 'cntal' for cutal, and it splits 'yanac ti' where the print has 'yanacti'; cicitħanbi- loses the bar ('cicithanbi-').

readB.comment: Near exact, with 'cutal' and 'yanacti' right; it renders the inverted question mark as '¡' and also drops the bar on cicitħanbi-.

language_seen: Spanish headwords with Yucatec Maya equivalents (Motul vol. 2, Spanish-Maya, manuscript)
my_transcription_head: 76 / Descaecido anssi: thonan: thoyan: / Descalçar çapatos: choch xanab / Descalçar calças: hos: pul: / Descalço: ixma xanab: / Descalabrar: paapol: chinpol / Descalabrado: paan vpol: / Descalabradura: cinil: cintanil: / Descaminada cosa: mabean: vt: mabean athan: / Descaminado que ha perdido el camino: catanbe[h/ti]: / Descanpar la lluuia: tzitzilha: haual vkaxal haa: / Descansar y descanso: helel: / Descanso dar a otra cosa: hele[c/ç]ah / Descansadero: heleb: lubay: boh cabal vlec / Descarado sin verguença: chic vuich: coyen vpacat. ☞ Vide / Desuergonçado: o[f/s]i [e/ç]sento: [last Maya word not certain to me]

readA.comment: Complete and in order; the worst errors are 'Descasarse quoad thorum' (torum) and 'ix maxanab' for ixma xanab; 'catan beh' may be a reasonable reading of an ambiguous ending.

readB.comment: Complete and in order; the worst error is 'çatanbeti' (the initial is c, not ç), and it normalises the scribe's 'Descanpar' to Spanish 'Descampar'; it honestly marks the ofi-çiento word as unclear.

language_seen: Kaqchikel (manuscript in Parra letters: cuatrillo-h and tresillo); not K'iche' as read B labels it
my_transcription_head: ha tannima ahoxel vacami . ti / quiban Conohel Christianos vi / nak, ha ꜯhinimaygovinak vi / que quinimah, que coqueçah, que / quiloꜫoh, tiquiluc, tiquipathna / uipequij ꜯhiquivaꜯh he Padres, Sa / çerdotes; heruta tacanimas, al / gualay qui ꜯhin ꜯhuvaꜯh Dios - / quere ga haroquicam, haga re / gheta lim, kiꜯih ꜯhiquix maca / mo, quix ꜯhuh ꜯhu, quix yoꜫoyo, / quix çak pile, quix çak maha ꜯhi / xibibal y vij tok ti vue tamah y / mac panigux: rumal vue maqui / he ynimam, vue maqui he yvo / queçam quiloꜫolah ꜯih vue pe / [catchword] ma   [ꜯh = cuatrillo-h; ꜫ = tresillo; 'vue' final letter possibly tresillo, uncertain]

readA.comment: It silently normalises the cuatrillo-h to ch/th ('quichin chuvach', 'thiquivath'), drops the 'ki' of kitzih ('tzih thiquix'), and misreads 'he rutotacanimas' (heruta tacanimas) and 'tiquipathan' (tiquipathna).

readB.comment: Closest to the image (it reads 'kitzih', 'heruta tacanimas' and 'tiquipathna', and renders the cuatrillo as 'tt'), but it invents a '<margin>ez</margin>' (only show-through is there), uses 'vuz' for vue, and mislabels the language as K'iche'.

language_seen: Yucatec Maya (left column) with parallel Spanish (right column), 1851 print
my_transcription_head: —12— / á lukez ú bonlilóob in puczi- / kal, iix á cilichcuntic in pi- / xan. / Olalcuntez, in Dios, in / puczikal, utial in bóotic in ke- / banóob, utial in uetħic le / tuntahulóob cá cú talelóob, / utial in cumcintic le kaz ɔi- / bolahóob cá cú ahauinticen, / iix utial in nahaltic le tibil- / beilóob cá cú kanantaltené. || mi voluntad, quiteis las man- / chas de mi corazon, y santi- / fiqueis mi alma.

readA.comment: Near exact in both columns and keeps the languages apart; it drops the bar on uetħic/tħanil/cħecħóob ('uethic', 'ah chechóob'), and 'coczioil' is probably cocziɔil.

readB.comment: It keeps both columns apart, but repeatedly misreads 'titel' as 'ti lel' (4 times: 'mukanil ti lel nummiaóob'), has 'coczicil', and also drops the barred h.

language_seen: Kaqchikel (manuscript facsimile with Parra tresillo Ɛ/ꜫ and cuatrillo-h); not K'iche' as read B labels it
my_transcription_head: 62 / chikichin Andres ~ nima mac pe tikaban ri vemani kome / vayh chupam rimevayihbal ꜫih Martin, kitzih an chini / ma mac tikaban rumal kitzih ha rucah rupixa Sancta Y / glesia Andres ~ naklaga chokpam nak on chi ꜫih riꜫa- / tom vi camiçanel mac chivetn maqui komevayih chupam / Martin. ~ Tavagazah na an chupam vae chohmilih / kitzih bijn can tzolꜫomin can chupam kaghabal, xuyacan ri / katata chikichin at nunimal vue taga tikaget vi tiketa / mah vi ruchohmil ri kitzih ha nima mevayibal ꜫih, xahani / bal ꜫih retam rughiquibaan ruꜫatom pe can xauiha ri S.to / Padre Papa rox in bi paulo, xaxere kitzih vi chinima cami / çanel mac, ruꜫatom can chiquih yndios vinak, ri vegoh ma- [ch = cuatrillo-h; ꜫ = tresillo]

readA.comment: It misreads the tresillo as l/t/ç ('rulatom' for ruꜫatom, 'rienton' for riꜫatom, 'ruçihil' for ruꜫihil, 'tekah'), and invents 'Eih' in place of kitzih ('Ehohmilih / Eih bijn'); it also has 'vox' for rox and 'tnga' for taga.

readB.comment: It renders the tresillo consistently as 'E' ('ru Eatom', 'Eekah', 'rox'), but has 'ruzihil' (tresillo read as z), 'kitz bijn', 'tzolcomin', 'chokmilah', and the K'iche' label is wrong.

En el vientre de la siem- / pre Virgen Maria encarnò / por obra del Espiritu Santo.

readA.comment: Complete; it keeps the Kaqchikel and Spanish columns apart and preserves most Parra letters, but renders the same letters inconsistently: heng as 'h' in ahaval/ꜫopoh but as 'ꜩ' in 'taꜩ' and 'ʒ' in 'tioʒil', and tresillo as both 'Ɛ' and 'ꜫ'; it also normalises the long s in the Kaqchikel column ('santoilah' with ſ inconsistently).
